Which Provision of the Family Courts Act, 1984, provides for the execution of decrees and orders?
How is the evidence of a formal character in any suit or proceedings submitted before a Family Court under the Family Courts Act, 1984?
What is the limitation period to dispose of the application for maintenance pendent elite and expenses of proceedings under Section 24 of the Hindu Marriage Act, 1955?

options.1: Within 90 days from the date of service of notice
options.2: Within 30 days from the date of service of notice
options.3: Within 120 days from the date of service of notice
options.4: Within 60 days from the date of service of notice

questions.question: With reference to Section 18 of the Hindu Succession Act, 1956, heirs related to an intestate by full blood shall be preferred to heirs related by ________, if the nature of the relationship is the same in every other respect.
Within how many years of marriage will a husband and his relatives be held responsible and liable for the dowry death of his wife under Section 304B of the Indian Penal Code?
Who has the jurisdiction to entertain the application with regard to guardianship of the person of the minor under Section 9 (1) of the Guardians and Wards Act, 1890?

With reference to Section 13 of the Guardians and Wards Act, 1890, on the day fixed for the hearing of the application, or as soon afterwards as may be, the Court shall hear such evidence as may be ______ in support of or in opposition to the application.
What is the duty of a guardian of minor’s property under Section 27 of the Guardians and Wards Act, 1890?

options.1: To sale, transfer or lease the property
options.2: To mortgage or create third party rights on the property
options.3: To collect all the rents and charges in his own account
options.4: To do all acts which are reasonable and proper for the realisation, protection or benefit of the property

questions.question: What is the kind of relationship a guardian needs to maintain with a ward as per Section 20 of the Guardians and Wards Act, 1890?

options.4: As may be directed by the Court

questions.question: What is the kind of ownership of any property possessed by a Hindu female under Section 14 of the Hindu Succession Act, 1956?

options.3: Remaining ownership after dividing share for Hindu males
options.4: Remaining ownership after dividing share for Hindu mother and father

questions.question: What is the limitation period for concluding the trial of the petition from the date of service of notice on the respondent under Section 21B (2) of the Hindu Marriage Act, 1955?
Under which Provision of the Guardians and Wards Act, 1890, can the Court discharge a guardian due to a sufficient reason approving such application?

When does the Court have the power to by order, define, restrict or extend powers of guardian of property appointed or declared by the Court with respect to the property of the ward under Section 32 of the Guardians and Wards Act, 1890?

options.1: Where a guardian of the property of a ward is not the Collector
options.3: Where the Court wishes to appoint a new guardian
options.4: Where the Court feels that the Collector has ill intentions

questions.question: What is the limitation period under the Family Courts Act, 1984, for filing an appeal from the date of judgment or order of a Family Court?

With reference to Section 23 of the Guardians and Wards Act, 1890, a Collector appointed or declared by the Court to be guardian of the person or property, or both, of a minor shall, in all matters connected with the guardianship of his ward, be subject to the control of the _______ or of such authority as that Government, by notification in the Official Gazette, appointed in this behalf.
What happens to the transfer of immovable property made by the guardian in contravention of Sections 28 and 29 of the Guardians and Wards Act, 1890?

options.1: Voidable at the instance of any other person affected thereby

questions.question: Under which Provision of the Guardians and Wards Act, 1890, can the Court appoint a person to audit the accounts for a minor’s property?

With reference to Section 38 of the Guardians and Wards Act, 1890, on the death of one of two or more joint guardians, the guardianship continues to the survivor or survivors until a _______ is made by the Court.
What is the penalty for removal of ward from jurisdiction under Section 44 of the Guardians and Wards Act, 1890?

options.1: Fine not exceeding five thousand rupees, or to imprisonment in the civil jail for a term which may extend to six months.
options.2: Fine not exceeding ten thousand rupees, or to imprisonment in the civil jail for a term which may extend to three months.
options.3: Fine not exceeding twenty five thousand rupees, or to imprisonment in the civil jail for a term which may extend to nine months.
options.4: Fine not exceeding one thousand rupees, or to imprisonment in the civil jail for a term which may extend to six months.
